name: The Final Experiment
summary:
The doors slam shut. The alarms wail. And then it hits you: the thing hunting you isn’t just a monster—
it used to be your friend.

The Final Experiment is a high-intensity, asymmetric VR horror where survival is never guaranteed and laughter mixes with terror. One player becomes the failed mutation, a nightmare of claws and fury. Everyone else? Just terrified survivors, scrambling to outwit and outpace the inevitable.
